tasks.GrassTypeIncrease: Adds the newly bought grass type cards to the total.
tasks.InitialCardCount: Counts the initial number of cards for each type.
tasks.TotalCardsCalculation: Calculates the new total number of cards after changes.
tasks.WaterTypeLoss: Subtracts the lost water type cards from the total.
tasks.WaterTypePercentageCalculation: Calculates the percentage chance that a randomly picked card will be a water type.
